**Hi everyone — has anyone had their application closed for "missing base documents" that were actually submitted?**

We're an unmarried couple (Israeli + foreign partner), procedure 5.2.0009, Tel Aviv office. Hoping someone here has seen this before.
* **22/07** — Submitted the online application with all base documents (passport copy, Ash/1, declaration, birth certificate, marital status certificate, police certificate — all translated and notarised) and paid the fee.
* **03/08** — Got an email asking for additional documents. It only asked for residential utility bills, nothing about certificates.
* **01/09** — Submitted the bills through the online form, 16 days before the 17/09 deadline. We have the gov.il confirmation.
* **23/09** — Letter closing the application because "base documents, i.e. public, original and authenticated certificates, were not submitted."

So the certificates went in on day one, their own follow-up request never mentioned them, and the closure letter doesn't mention our 01/09 submission at all.

We're preparing a written objection within the 21 days. Has anyone been through this — did the objection work, or did you end up filing a new application?

Thanks in advance, any experience helps.
